status_note: The first main search completed 240 cases and exact repeats. Eight workers now continue from its verified winner; two test early-fertility weight 3,000. Up to 10 local workers ran; cluster search never launched because SSH access expired.
review_notes: Bequests count all positive estates against a child-directed SCF target. Older-wealth income and first-birth housing-response measurements also retain approximations.
Weights and the curvature interval remain provisional. This local search does not establish an optimum or prove that targets are unreachable; identification still needs assessment.
Preparation failures: one zero-solve cluster submission failed; two local smokes were cancelled after source-pin drift. Fresh pinned snapshots replaced them; no accepted result was relabeled.
next_steps: Compare the early-fertility weighting experiment, then profile curvature and fertility taste scales with every fertility target retained.
Review credit, interest, tenure scale, rental choices and income/wealth inputs; separately test the finer housing grid and conception schedule.
Restore cluster access, collect the legacy replay and cross-host checks, then extend the unchanged search from independently repeated points.

repeats.status: The first main and unit-weight winners each have two exact final repeats and 17 inspected plots. The main continuation passed two further exact smokes; its final repeats remain pending.

benchmark.status: At the same starting point, warm prices required 13 price evaluations versus 19 without them: observed local runtimes were 231 versus 312 seconds. All moment differences were below 1e-5. The old-floor Torch replay remains uncollected.
